annotation.title_clean: HOUSE LAUNCHES BIPARTISAN TASK FORCE ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
annotation.title_en: House Launches Bipartisan Task Force on Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of Congressman Ted Lieu, U.S. House of Representatives
annotation.summary_en: Press release from Rep. Ted Lieu's office announcing that Speaker Johnson and Leader Jeffries have set up a 24-member bipartisan House Task Force on AI. It is chaired by Jay Obernolte and co-chaired by Ted Lieu. The task force will write a report with guiding principles, recommendations and policy proposals that balance AI innovation with guardrails.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes a bipartisan House Task Force on AI with 12 members appointed by each party leader
Task force to produce comprehensive report with guiding principles, recommendations and bipartisan policy proposals
Aims to maintain US AI leadership and competitiveness while considering guardrails
Emphasises consumer protection, national security, and equitable benefits of AI
